Fix #398: don't let open handles block renaming or deleting files on Windows

Renaming a file loaded in the editor failed, and any file loaded in the editor
stayed locked until ART was quit. Both are the same bug: on Windows a rename or
delete needs the file to have been opened with FILE_SHARE_DELETE.

The main culprit is handle inheritance: CreateProcessW was called with
bInheritHandles = TRUE and no handle list, so every inheritable handle was
duplicated into the child -- including any restrictive one open when the
exiftool "-stay_open" worker started, which then keeps the file locked until
ART exits.

- utils.{h,cc}: add g_fopen_shared_read()/g_open_shared_read(), using
  FILE_SHARE_DELETE and non-inheritable handles on Windows; route the source
  reads in myfile.cc (incl. MYFILE_MMAP), imageio.cc and metadata.cc through
  them.
- subprocess.cc: restrict inheritance to the handles the child needs, via
  PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST; pass FALSE when it needs none.
- imageio.cc: close the FILE* on loadJPEG's error exits, release the IMFILE
  when TIFFClientOpen fails.
- rawimagesource.cc: delete the RawImage on decode failure -- numFrames is
  still 0, so ~RawImageSource would not free it.
- metadata.{h,cc}: add Exiv2Metadata::removeFromCache(), called before a
  rename or delete.

Fix heap corruption when panning/zooming with Spot removal edit mode active

  - boxblur(): clamp radx/rady to the buffer size; guided smoothing/denoise
    could pass a radius larger than half the tile width/height for small
    crop tiles, reading past the end of the buffer.
  - Add a dedicated mTweak mutex so Crop::fullUpdate() and
    ImProcCoordinator::process() can no longer race on the shared
    params/paramsBackup while a TweakOperator (Spot removal's edit mode)
    is active; this was a heap-use-after-free. Lock ordering vs mProcessing
    is kept consistent to avoid deadlock, and the racy tweakOperator
    pointer is cached per call to avoid leaking the lock if edit mode is
    toggled mid-update.
  - PipetteBuffer::resize(): fix && that should have been || when deciding
    to reallocate LabBuffer, which kept a wrong-sized buffer when only one
    dimension changed.
  - BackBuffer::setDrawRectangle(): fix copy-paste bug checking newH twice
    instead of newW once.

lensexif: add NikonCorrectionData for embedded NEF lens correction

Nikon Z bodies store distortion and vignetting coefficients in TIFF tag
0xc7d5 of the raw SubIFD (a nested TIFF, not part of the makernote).
Parse it into the existing CorrectionData representation.

Coefficients are stored highest-power-first with an implicit constant
term of 1; reading them in file order makes the vignette gain at the
image centre come out wrong on lenses where the slot ExifTool doesn't
expose is non-zero.

Block 0x07 guessed to be lateral CA, empirically confirmed.

Thanks to the folks at discuss.pixls.us for the initial findings.
